title: TwofaFlow::refetch mark is taken before the refetch is sent and lost when the send fails
trigger: Cancel a 2FA reset or finish a login-email step while the connection is closing or the chats path is inactive, so refresh_password_state returns Err
effect: The cached password state stays out of date (old pending reset date, old login email) until something else refetches it; the refetch mark is gone (mem::take then `let _ =`, connect/core/mod.rs:632)
fix: keep the mark until refresh_password_state is sent (or a PasswordFlight::InFlight request holds it); clear it on that request's answer

title: Inline query answers are matched by (chat, bot) and the Loading stage, not by the request that asked
trigger: Type @bot query1, then edit to query2 quickly: both getInlineQueryResults go out, the slot is Loading for query2, query1's answer arrives first
effect: The picker shows query1's results as the result of query2 (the code's own `ponytail` comment admits it); the slot's InlineQueryFetch::Loading holds no RequestId (session_apply_queries.rs:26)
fix: InlineQueryFetch::Loading(RequestId); apply only the answer whose id the slot holds

title: A failed folder loadChats page (anything but 404) ends folder paging with no retry stage and no error
trigger: Select a folder tab with many chats and have the second loadChats page fail with a timeout or 500
effect: The tab keeps a partial list for the session: folder paging continues only from an ok (core/mod.rs:728) or re-selecting the tab; main and archive lists retry through ListPaging::Retrying but folders only have folder_chats_exhausted
fix: HashMap<folder id, ListPaging> so a folder fails into Retrying like the main list

title: tray_refresh mark is drained by upkeep and lost when the getChatActiveStories send fails
trigger: Post a story from another client while offline/send refused; frame_upkeep drains tray_refresh then `let _ = get_chat_active_stories(..)`
effect: The own story never appears in the tray until some unrelated update refreshes that chat
fix: keep the mark until the send succeeds (re-insert on Err) or model the poster's tray as Fetch with Outdated

title: A failed GetBursts goes back to Unasked, so it is re-sent on every ingest of the live story call
trigger: Watch a live story while getCustomEmojiReactionAnimations keeps failing (flood, offline server error); maybe_fetch_live_bursts runs from ingest on each group call update
effect: Request loop at the group-call update rate; never reaches a Failed stage
fix: LiveBursts::Failed (asked once per session, like Fetch) and hold the RequestId in Requested

title: Rollback of an overlapping privacy save restores `previous` over a newer save
trigger: Set the inactive-session timeout to 30 (previous 180), then to 60 (previous 30) before the first answers; the first request fails (flood, offline)
effect: The row snaps back to 180 while the second save succeeded on the server (60); the screen is wrong until the page is reopened. Same for SetNewChatPrivacy
fix: Hold the in-flight save as a stage with its RequestId (like scope_saves/reaction_saves) and roll back only when the failing request is the newest, or compare `shown` as RequestRollback does

title: Thread history answers and errors are matched by origin chat+message, not by the RequestId held in ThreadStatus::LoadingHistory
trigger: Open a thread; while its first page (LoadingHistory(r)) is in flight, an older/newer page of the same origin (or a re-sent page) lands or fails
effect: Any matching page flips LoadingHistory(r) to Ready, or any matching failure (incl. an older/newer page, or a getMessageThread re-resolve) flips it to Failed, while request r is still out; the thread shows empty/Failed then fills in or sticks
fix: Compare the answer's RequestId with LoadingHistory(r) (grep shows nothing but connect/threads.rs reads it); other pages go through the history's own older/newer stage

title: An own reply sent while the thread window has unloaded newer replies replaces the window without marking in-flight older/newer pages stale
trigger: Open a comment thread at its first unread reply (has_newer), scroll so a newer or older page request is in flight, send a reply: ThreadView::note_live calls reset_window, but Session::thread_upsert only calls drop_thread_pages_past when the row was stored and after trim_live, never for the reset; the in-flight page then passes the stale_pages check in apply_thread_history
effect: The late page is merged into the reset window across a gap and overwrites next_from_message_id, so rows are missing or paging resumes from the wrong place until the user jumps to the latest
fix: Make note_live return whether it replaced the window and have thread_upsert call drop_thread_pages_past for both ends (as note_live_topic_message does); better, hold the page request in OlderEnd/NewerEnd::Loading{request} so reset_window drops it

title: Any failure of a recent post's getMessage is stored as Missing for good
trigger: Open channel statistics with a flaky connection (or while the account logs out: a lost request settles as a 408 failure); GetStatsPost fails, error.rs calls post_missing; fetch_stats_post skips keys in posts
effect: The post row is hidden from Recent posts for the rest of the session and never refetched
fix: posts value becomes Fetch<StatsPostPreview> with Missing only for a real not-found error; a transient failure leaves Failed/Idle so the next open asks again

title: A failed first page of Stories or Gifts writes count 0 into the chat's media counts
trigger: Open a profile gallery on a bad connection, the Gifts or Stories page fails (or its send fails); fail_profile_tab sets chat_media_counts[key]=0, which hides the tab once it is not active, and the counts are never fetched again this session
effect: The tab disappears from the bar and cannot be retried until the app restarts, as if the profile had no gifts or stories
fix: Keep Failed in the tab stage and leave the count unknown (None) so the tab stays visible with Retry

title: Tab visibility reads media counts that are fetched once per chat per session and never refreshed
trigger: Open a chat's gallery while it has no files or links, receive some, reopen the gallery: visible_tabs still sees count 0 (fetch_chat_media_counts returns early when the entry exists; nothing invalidates it on new messages)
effect: The Files, Links or other tabs stay hidden although the chat now has such media
fix: Counts as Fetch with Outdated on gallery open, or refetch on every open

title: searchWebApp answer is matched to the waiting flow by bot id, not by the RequestId
trigger: Click two t.me/<bot>/<app1> and t.me/<bot>/<app2> links of the same bot before the first searchWebApp answers
effect: The first answer (app1's FoundWebApp, skip_confirmation, request_write_access) is taken by the flow now waiting for app2 (take_search_for compares bot_id only), so app2 is launched or consented to with app1's terms; the second answer finds no flow and is dropped
fix: WebApps::found: Option<(RequestId, Result<..>)> and Searching { request: RequestId, awaited } matched on the request

title: A Failed message translation counts as done, so the pump never asks for it again
trigger: Open a translated chat while offline or during a client restart (abandon_translation records Failed("send"), fail_orphaned_translations records Failed("lost")), or let TDLib refuse once.
effect: needs_translation is message_translation(..).is_none(), so the message keeps its original text in a translated chat for the rest of the session, although ConnectDriver::translate_message does retry Failed.
fix: needs_translation is true for Failed (with a retry bound or a Failed-with-retry variant), as translate_message already allows
